name: io.github.BartWaardenburg/postnl-mcp
title: PostNL
description: Create shipments, generate barcodes, track parcels, and find pickup locations via the PostNL API

environmentVariables.name: POSTNL_CUSTOMER_CODE
environmentVariables.description: PostNL customer code, used for barcodes and shipments.

environmentVariables.name: POSTNL_CUSTOMER_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: PostNL customer number, used in shipment requests.

environmentVariables.name: POSTNL_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Response cache lifetime in seconds. Use 0 to turn the cache off.

environmentVariables.name: POSTNL_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool categories to enable: shipping, tracking, delivery, locations.
